# ANXA Infra

> ANXA Infra (anxainfra.com, also written Anxa Infra or anxainfra) is a B2B construction and infrastructure services company headquartered in Hyderabad, India, working across India. It provides design, engineering and construction (EPC / design-build) for developers, enterprises, industrial operators and public bodies. Project 49 is ANXA Infra's separate real estate venture.

## Key facts
- Company: ANXA Infra. "anxainfra" is its short name and web address, not a typo.
- What it does: design, engineering and construction under one team, from the first soil test to final handover
- Industries: residential and commercial buildings; industrial and manufacturing facilities; data centres and mission-critical infrastructure; railways and transportation infrastructure
- Clients: developers, enterprises, industrial operators, public bodies
- Headquarters: Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Projects across India.
- Contact: WhatsApp +91 81792 59334
- Real estate venture: Project 49, 49 one-of-a-kind homes in Hyderabad across seven design philosophies (Light, Air, Art, Roots, Earth, Silence, Future)
